summary: Bootstrap CV resamples assign duplicate context copies distinct cluster ids (bc{k}) so GroupKFold can split one original context across train/test folds, violating the registered no-leakage guarantee
gate_pass=false panel selections only warn; eval dispatchers read the panel JSON without checking gate_pass, so trained-side GPU can run on a failed panel
Marker analysis iterates every per_cell file in the output root without filtering to the selected panel; stale smoke/expansion cells can enter registered statistics
dCV-R2 bootstrap groups CV folds by fresh per-instance ids, so duplicate contexts straddle train/test folds; CI ~2x too narrow under a null. Group stat_dcv by original context before Phase 7.
